newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF grants securities branch licence to Fidelity.
newsitem.headline: MOF grants securities branch licence to Fidelity.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) said on Friday that it had granted a securities licence to Fidelity Brokerage Services (Japan) LLC, a subsidiary of Fidelity Brokerage Services Inc.
The licence will allow the firm to provide brokerage services, such as dealing, broking and selling securities, MOF said in a statement.
Fidelity Brokerage Services said its new Tokyo branch will replace its representative office, which opened in October 1996.

Donna M. Morris, senior vice-president and manager of the new Tokyo branch, said in a statement that with the licence, the firm will offer mutual funds and brokerage services to Japanese individual and institutional investors.
Fidelity Brokerage Services Inc is the U.S. brokerage arm of Boston-based mutual fund manager Fidelity Investments.
